public_rationale: OpenRouter's analysis, updated July 1, 2026, uses request logs through June 14 [e1]. It reports DeepSeek's token share rising from about 5% in February–March to nearly 20% by the start of June [e1]. Xiaomi, MiniMax and Tencent also gained token share over the six-month comparison period [e1]. These gains support rapid Chinese-model traction on the platform Marcus referenced, reaching into early June [e1].
limitations: The observations do not cover the full June 1–25 target period or establish continuous growth within it.
OpenRouter token shares do not establish worldwide user, enterprise-deployment, spending or revenue shares.
Agentic workloads drove most of DeepSeek's gain, so token-share growth does not establish proportional growth in users or spending [e1].
The analysis was published after Marcus's June 26 statement.

public_payload.normalized_proposition: Chinese AI models are rapidly gaining market traction.

statement.excerpt: • Chinese models are gaining traction, fast.
statement.document_title: The month Generative AI lost its mojo

our_interpretation: Traction means actual usage or adoption of models developed by Chinese labs.
The accompanying OpenRouter reference makes usage on that platform a relevant measure. It does not establish worldwide revenue share.
The post describes developments during June. I assess June 1–25, using earlier observations as the comparison baseline.
Fast means substantial growth over weeks or months; Marcus supplies no numerical threshold.
criteria.support_condition: Comparable usage records show substantial recent growth in Chinese-model usage or share, reaching into June before publication.
criteria.contradiction_condition: Comparable records show Chinese-model usage and adoption were broadly stagnant or declining during the described period.
